_comment: Central image manifest. Every image the UI shows is looked up here by key. `kind`: stock (fetched from Pexels on first run when PEXELS_API_KEY is set), generated (composed by scripts/make-images.mjs), person (portraits fetched by `npm run fetch:people` from randomuser.me; a neutral silhouette shows until the file exists), text. `fallback` shows while `file` is missing.

openai.prompt: A view down an ordinary residential street in a small Atlantic Canadian port city on a cold foggy morning. Parked cars, power lines, a wet pavement, the far end of the street lost in fog. Nobody in shot. Shot on a phone camera held at chest height, f/1.8, ISO 400. Slightly crooked horizon, focus a little off, sensor noise in the shadows, a colour cast nothing corrected for. Framing is casual and not composed. This is an ordinary unedited JPEG straight off the card - no retouching, no colour grading, no stylisation, nothing tidied. No text, no watermark, no border, no logo, no people identifiable.
